title: Sourcing And Process End To End
description: Get sourcing and process working end to end after restructure. Immediate blocker: bun run dev:process:3d fails building semio-s-plugin-process (missing blake3 dep, memo/kernel borrow conflicts, session lifetime in volume replay). Fix process plugin compile, verify process3d boots, then verify sourcing app boots and works.
summary: Fixed semio-s-plugin-process compile blockers that stopped process3d (and blocked related sourcing/process flows): added blake3 dependency; scoped kernel MutexGuards so memo table mutations no longer conflict; fixed processed_mesh/processed_volume temporary lifetimes. Verified cargo build -p semio-s-plugin-process --target wasm32-wasip2, bun run dev:process:3d (Vite :6022 + plugin build + hot-swap watch), and bun run dev:sourcing (Vite :6081 + plugin build + hot-swap watch).
